notes.title: Galaxy on Fire 2 Full HD Product Update
notes.content:
ENGLISH Patchnotes - Galaxy on Fire 2 Full HD PC
- Bugfix: Fixed a bug where ship did keep firing after mouse button has been released
- Changed Joystick mapping: Improved default mapping of analog axes for joysticks
- Fight Control Systems: Improved detection of flight control systems and similar input devices
- Joystick and Gamepad Input: Improved signal processing of analog inputs for joysticks and gamepads
- Controls: Increased deadzone for "roll" and "throttle" for joysticks and gamepads
- Settings: "Reset All" in the controls tab of the launcher now resets deadzone as well
- Language Error: Special characters in the Steam installation path will no longer lead to "error language" texts in the launcher and crash on game startup

notes.title: Pre-Purchase Now - Galaxy on Fire 2™ Full HD, 20% Off!
notes.content:
Pre-Purchase Galaxy on Fire 2™ Full HD Now and get 20% Off! This offer will end August 21st at 10AM Pacific Time.

A hyperdrive malfunction sends intergalactic adventurer and war hero Keith T. Maxwell tumbling through space and time. Awakening 35 years later at the far end of the galaxy, he quickly finds himself fighting for his life against a mysterious alien armada that is wreaking havoc on the warring races occupying this volatile sector of space. Despite his efforts to return home, Keith is drawn into a deadly plot to investigate and stop this alien menace. Along the way he must fight space pirates, trade cargo, explore new territories and negotiate with shady characters to uncover the truth about this powerful enemy and ultimately find his way home. Old friends and new enemies join forces as Keith takes command of a dangerous intergalactic mission that sends him deep into enemy space, bringing the war to an explosive conclusion that will set the entire galaxy on fire.
